verdict.rationale: Quo's own marketing and pricing docs say a business number can be set up in minutes and that each user gets a new local or toll-free number, so quick provisioning of a local number is a first-party capability. Nothing in the evidence shows searching available inventory by area code, through the UI or the API. Missing for 10: documented search of available numbers by area code, API or UI provisioning docs for number purchase, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the 'minutes' setup claim.

support.subject: As a founder, I can search available numbers by area code and buy a local number in minutes

citations.quote: Set up a business number in minutes
One new or ported phone number (local or toll-free) per user
Canadian local and toll-free virtual numbers from anywhere
